topic: Data duplication issue in virtual facility sessions
summary_markdown:
A user reported a recurring data quality issue when generating session records for virtual facilities. When running the query, the resulting dataset contained duplicate entries, specifically two distinct datasets where the `created` field differed by exactly 30 seconds, suggesting the query was executed twice in quick succession.

The user provided a complex SQL query designed to populate the `allunite.device_session` table using data from virtual facility dictionaries and existing device sessions. The issue persists regardless of whether the query is run via keyboard shortcuts or UI methods.

Discussion focused on potential causes, including system behavior mimicking contact bounce (signal instability) and IDE/query execution timing issues.
decisions: The user will attempt to execute the data insertion process using the graphical user interface (UI) instead of keyboard commands to see if it resolves the duplication issue.
action_items: User to follow up with further questions regarding the session data duplication if the UI method fails or if new issues arise.
